name: Home Screen Manager
description: TEST BUILD — Designs, orders, and renders hybrid Jellyfin/Abyss home sections using manual media, collections, metadata tags, and libraries.
overview: TEST BUILD — Home Screen Manager creation, ordering, rendering, and Abyss customization for Jellyfin 10.11.11.

versions.changelog: Full browser-runtime rebuild: isolates Dashboard and playback routes, renders cached Home rows independently of media-bar and display-preference work, bounds and pages all startup reads, removes synthetic/session playback behavior, restores My List with series-aware episode cards, recognizes native ratings for Top 10-50, maps activity episodes to Series, and adds Random ordering plus Poster art.
